make_dataset: create a dataset from a given path using lazy, cached, raw, or mmap implementation
make_builder: build an IndexedDatasetBuilder or MMapIndexedDatasetBuilder for writing binary indexed dataset files
infer_dataset_impl: infer the dataset implementation type from an existing index file at a given path
IndexedDatasetBuilder_finalize: finalize an IndexedDatasetBuilder by writing the index file with offsets and sizes
MMapIndexedDatasetBuilder_add_item: add a tensor item to an MMapIndexedDatasetBuilder for memory-mapped dataset construction
